units: <cite ref="Pesachim 115a:9">Pes. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שׁטִיבּוּלוֹ במשקה וכ׳</he> whatever eatable is dipped into a liquid, requires hand-washing (before partaking of it).
<cite ref="Gittin 70a:11">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>יהא רגיל בט׳ וכ׳</he> let him make it a habit to eat relishes dipped (in vinegar &c.) in the summer as well as &c.
<cite ref="Beitzah 18b:6">Bets. 18ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 111a:6">Sabb. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>קודם ט׳</he> before the antepast.
<cite ref="Pesachim 115b:2">Pes. 115ᵇ</cite> <he>בט׳ ראשון</he> when dipping the first time; a. e.

senses.gloss: (טָבַל II) the act which makes food subject to priestly gifts (טֶבֶל).
units: Y. Ḥall. III, 59ᵇ top גילגולה טִיבּוּלָהּ the rolling of the dough makes it Tebel
